_doc: BUG-3115: shared by internal/models/title_limit_parity_test.go and web/src/lib/items/titleLimit.test.ts. Each title is prefix + unit*count + suffix. go_space is every code point Go's unicode.IsSpace accepts (the Go half enumerates the whole range and must find exactly these). If you add a case, add it here, not to one language's test.

cases.name: astral at the limit
cases.why: an emoji is ONE rune but TWO UTF-16 units; a .length or maxlength count would refuse this

cases.name: surrounding spaces are not counted
cases.why: the server validates the TrimSpace'd title

cases.name: NEL is trimmed by Go
cases.why: U+0085 is unicode.IsSpace but NOT stripped by JS String.trim

cases.name: BOM is NOT trimmed by Go
cases.why: U+FEFF is stripped by JS String.trim but is not unicode.IsSpace, so the server counts it
